fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { roofingCrews: "Build a JHA form template for my roofing crew's tear-off job. List the 5 steps in order, starting with setting roof anchors, with the hazards and controls for each step. Let the crew lead open it on his phone at the job and have each of the 4 crew members sign on that phone. Show the job as Ready only after all 4 have signed.", metalShops: "Build a JHA form for the casting grinding job in my metal shop. For each step, list the hazards and their controls, and tag every control as engineering, administrative, or PPE. If a hazard's only control is PPE, flag it as PPE only and email my safety manager, Isaura Velloway, with the step and the hazard so she can add a stronger control.", warehouses: "Build a JHA tracker for my warehouse jobs. When an injury report names a job, move that job's JHA to Under review and email the safety lead, Stellan Quaye, with the step named in the report. Show Under review to every crew that opens that JHA until he signs a revised version.", facilityTeams: "Build a JHA form for my facilities team's boiler room work. When I revise a JHA, save it as a new version and ask all 12 technicians on that job to sign it. Show how many have signed. Email each technician who has not signed every morning until they do, and list their names on a dashboard for my maintenance manager, Radomir Thornbeck." };

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: An injury report at Gorsedge Freight names step 3 of the pallet restack job, so the app marks its JHA Under review and emails safety lead Stellan Quaye.
